Dear Mr.,

With reference to your application, discussions and interview with us, we are pleased to appoint you as (Designation & Department) with TREEBOND COSMETIC PVT LTD, address, subject to the terms and conditions contained in this letter and the applicable Company policies.
Your date of joining the Company shall be 07.09.2026, on which date you are required to report for duty.

This appointment letter is issued in accordance with applicable labour laws and rules, including the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020, as applicable to the Company and the employee.
PARTICULARS OF APPOINTMENT

text: EFFECTIVE DATE OF APPOINTMENT
Your employment with the Company shall commence from 07.09.2026.
JOB ASSIGNMENT AND REPORTING

You shall report to the Management, or such other person as may be designated by the Company from time to time. You shall perform the duties and responsibilities assigned to you in accordance with your designation, experience and skills.
Your principal place of work shall be the Company's Office.

You may be required to travel within India or overseas in connection with Company business, including travel-related assignments, meetings, conferences, client coordination and other official requirements.

The Company may modify or assign additional responsibilities from time to time in accordance with business requirements, provided such responsibilities are consistent with your position, experience and capabilities.
PLACE OF WORK AND TRANSFER
Your initial place of posting shall be the Company's Head Office.
Considering the business requirements of the Company, you may be required to travel to other locations in India or abroad in connection with official work.
The Company may transfer or post you to another office, establishment, branch or location of the Company, subject to applicable law and the terms of service applicable to such assignment.
Any proposed transfer to a separate legal entity, including a group or sister concern, shall be subject to the applicable employment arrangement and necessary documentation.
PROBATION

You shall be on probation for a period of six months from the date of joining. During the probation period, your performance, conduct and suitability for the position will be observed and reviewed. Upon satisfactory completion of the probation period, you will be confirmed in writing. The Company may, at its discretion, extend the probation period. You shall continue to be treated as a probationer until your confirmation is communicated to you in writing.

Based on your performance, conduct and overall suitability during the probation period, the Company may, at its discretion, reduce, waive or extend the probation period, or terminate your employment in accordance with the applicable terms of employment and law. Any material misrepresentation, concealment of material information or failure to disclose relevant information during the recruitment or employment process may result in appropriate disciplinary action, including termination, subject to applicable law and due process.

During the probation period, either party may terminate the employment by giving the applicable notice period or salary in lieu of notice, as specified in Clause 6 – Notice Period, subject to applicable law and Company policy.
NOTICE PERIOD
The applicable notice period shall be:

text: Any leave availed during the notice period shall be subject to Company approval and may, where applicable, result in a corresponding extension of the notice period, subject to applicable law and Company policy.
REMUNERATION
Your remuneration is as set out in Annexure A to this letter and shall be paid monthly through direct credit to your designated salary bank account, along with the applicable salary/wage slip.

Your remuneration, allowances, benefits and other applicable components shall be governed by the Company's policies and applicable law. The Company may revise or modify such components from time to time in accordance with its policies and applicable law.
Your remuneration shall be subject to applicable statutory deductions and taxes as per prevailing Government regulations.

Your salary shall be reviewed periodically in accordance with Company policy. Any increment or revision in remuneration shall be based on performance, business requirements and Management's decision and shall not be considered automatic.

The Company may, from time to time, restructure the salary components or remuneration structure in accordance with applicable law and Company policy, without reducing the overall contractual remuneration except as otherwise permitted by law.
WORKING HOURS, WEEKLY OFF, OVERTIME AND LEAVE

You shall ordinarily be required to work as per the working hours and weekly schedule prescribed by the Company from time to time, subject to applicable law. You shall be entitled to the applicable weekly rest day as prescribed under law and Company policy.
You shall be entitled to leave and holidays in accordance with the Company's Leave Policy and applicable law.
Depending on business requirements, work may occasionally be required beyond the normal working hours. Any overtime, where applicable, shall be governed by the Company's policy and applicable law.
You are expected to maintain punctuality, regular attendance and timely completion of your assigned responsibilities in accordance with the Company's policies and business requirements.
STATUTORY SOCIAL SECURITY AND EMPLOYEE BENEFITS

You shall be entitled to statutory social security benefits and other employee benefits in accordance with applicable law and Company policy, as amended from time to time, subject to eligibility and applicable conditions.

Where applicable and subject to statutory eligibility, you shall be covered under the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), including UAN where applicable, Employees' State Insurance (ESIC), gratuity, bonus and other applicable statutory benefits in accordance with the prevailing applicable laws and regulations.

Eligible women employees shall be entitled to maternity benefits in accordance with applicable law and the Company's policy, including applicable maternity leave, nursing breaks and protection of employment as prescribed by law.
WORKPLACE HEALTH & SAFETY
The Company is committed to maintaining a safe, healthy and professional office environment.
You shall comply with all applicable workplace safety requirements, Company policies, office procedures and lawful instructions issued by the Management.
Any workplace accident, unsafe condition, harassment or other workplace concern should be promptly reported to HR department.
Where a medical examination is required by applicable law or is reasonably necessary for the nature of the position, the Company may require such examination in accordance with applicable law.
PERFORMANCE, PROMOTION AND INCREMENT

Your performance shall be reviewed periodically based on your responsibilities, performance, conduct, attendance and other relevant factors. Promotion, increment, change in designation or enhancement of responsibilities shall be subject to Company policy, business requirements and Management's decision.
GENERAL CODE OF CONDUCT

Your employment with the Company is on a full-time basis. You are expected to devote your working time, attention and skills to the Company's business and responsibilities assigned to you. You shall not undertake any other employment, business, professional assignment or remunerative activity that conflicts with your duties or interests of the Company without prior written approval from Management.

You may be required to travel within India or overseas in connection with Company business, meetings, client requirements, conferences, business development or other official assignments, as reasonably required by the Company.
You shall maintain professional conduct and comply with the Company's policies, rules, procedures, Code of Conduct and business ethics, as amended from time to time.

You shall maintain strict confidentiality of the Company's confidential, proprietary and business information that comes to your knowledge during your employment and shall not disclose or misuse such information except as required for the performance of your duties or as authorised by the Company.

You shall not directly or indirectly solicit, accept or receive any commission, rebate, kickback, improper benefit, gift or other personal advantage from any person, vendor, client, business partner or other party having business dealings with the Company, except as permitted under the Company's applicable policy.

You shall conduct yourself professionally and respectfully towards colleagues, clients, vendors, business partners and other persons associated with the Company. Any misconduct or violation of Company policies may result in appropriate disciplinary action in accordance with applicable law and Company procedures.

During your employment, you shall avoid any activity or outside engagement that creates an actual or potential conflict of interest with the Company. Any such conflict shall be disclosed to Management promptly.

Unauthorised or prolonged absence may be treated as a matter of misconduct and may result in appropriate action in accordance with the Company's attendance policy, applicable law and due process. The employee may be required to provide an explanation for such absence.
CONFIDENTIALITY AND DATA PROTECTION

During and after employment, you shall maintain confidentiality regarding the Company's confidential, proprietary and commercially sensitive information, including client and traveller information, employee information, supplier/vendor information, pricing and commercial information, travel itineraries and booking information, business plans and strategies, financial information, Company systems, passwords and access credentials, and internal documents, records and correspondence.
You shall not disclose, copy, misuse or share such information except for legitimate Company work or where disclosure is required by law.
INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

Any documents, reports, formats, processes, content, systems, presentations, databases or other work product created by you in the course of your employment for Company business shall belong to the Company, subject to applicable law.
You shall not use or disclose Company work product or confidential information for personal or unauthorised purposes.
COMPANY PROPERTY
All Company property provided to you, including laptop, mobile device, ID card, documents, files, equipment, access credentials and other assets, shall remain the property of the Company.
You shall take reasonable care of Company property and return all such property upon transfer, resignation, termination or whenever requested by the Company.
Any recovery for loss or damage shall be made only in accordance with applicable law and Company policy.
TRAVEL AND BUSINESS EXPENSES
Based on business requirements, you may be required to travel or be assigned to another office, branch or establishment of the Company.
Approved business travel and related expenses shall be reimbursed in accordance with the Company's applicable Travel and Expense Policy.
DISCIPLINARY ACTION
You shall comply with the Company's policies, procedures, Code of Conduct and lawful instructions issued from time to time.

In case of misconduct, violation of Company policy, breach of confidentiality, fraud, dishonesty, conflict of interest, serious or repeated negligence, insubordination or other violation of employment conditions, the Company may initiate appropriate disciplinary action in accordance with applicable law and Company procedures.
Where disciplinary inquiry is required, the Company shall follow the applicable procedure and principles of natural justice.
TERMINATION AND SEPARATION

Termination for Misconduct	
The Company may take appropriate disciplinary action, including termination of employment, in cases of proven misconduct or material violation of the terms and conditions of employment, including fraud, dishonesty, breach of trust, serious insubordination, material conflict of interest, misappropriation of Company property or funds, material breach of confidentiality, deliberate falsification or concealment of material information, or serious violation of Company policies.
Where a disciplinary inquiry is required, the Company shall follow the applicable procedure and principles of natural justice.
Any misconduct established under the Company's Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Policy shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable POSH procedure and law.

Suspension Pending Inquiry	
The Company may, where considered necessary and in accordance with applicable law and Company policy, place an employee under suspension pending disciplinary inquiry. During such period, any subsistence allowance shall be paid in accordance with applicable law and Company policy.

Termination for Business Reasons	
Where employment is terminated for reasons other than misconduct, including organisational restructuring, change in business requirements or reduction in manpower requirements, the employee shall be entitled to applicable statutory dues and other benefits in accordance with applicable law and Company policy.

Exit Formalities and Final Settlement	
Upon separation, you shall complete the applicable exit formalities, including proper handover of responsibilities, documents, records, Company property, assets and other materials in your possession.

The Company shall process your final settlement of salary and other payable dues in accordance with applicable law and Company procedures. Any legitimate outstanding amount recoverable from you may be adjusted against the final settlement, subject to applicable law.

Recovery of Loss or Damage	
Where any loss or damage to Company property or funds is established to have resulted from an employee's unauthorised act, misconduct or breach of applicable employment terms, the Company may take appropriate action and seek recovery of the legitimate amount due, subject to applicable law and due process.

Retirement / Superannuation	
You shall retire from the services of the Company upon attaining the retirement age prescribed under the Company's applicable policy and terms of employment, subject to applicable law. Any extension of service, if permitted, shall be subject to written approval by Management.
POSH / WORKPLACE HARASSMENT
The Company is committed to providing a workplace free from sexual harassment.

Any complaint of sexual harassment shall be dealt with in accordance with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013, applicable rules and the Company's POSH Policy.
Employees are required to maintain professional and respectful behaviour towards colleagues, clients, vendors and other persons associated with the Company.
GRIEVANCE REDRESSAL AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION

In case of any grievance relating to your employment, you may approach HR or Management for resolution. The Company shall follow its applicable grievance redressal mechanism and applicable law, as amended from time to time.
Any employment-related dispute shall, where appropriate, be addressed through the Company's internal grievance mechanism and/or as per applicable law.
GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION
This appointment shall be governed by the applicable laws of India and the applicable laws/rules of the State of Gujarat.
Any employment-related dispute shall be dealt with through the applicable internal/statutory mechanism and the competent authority or court having appropriate jurisdiction.
VERIFICATION OF INFORMATION
This appointment is based on the information and documents furnished by you during the recruitment process.

If any material information or document is subsequently found to be false, materially misleading or fraudulently obtained, the Company may take appropriate action in accordance with applicable law and Company policy.
ACCEPTANCE
If the above terms and conditions are acceptable to you, please sign and return a duplicate copy of this appointment letter as acknowledgement of your acceptance.
We welcome you to TREEBOND COSMETIC PVT LTD and wish you a successful and mutually beneficial association with the Company.
For TREEBOND COSMETIC PVT LTD
